Chickpea, or garbanzo bean (Cicer arietinum), is a plant of the legume family grown as a pulse crop. Its seeds, about 0.5–1.5 cm in diameter, are eaten as food. GREENODIN GRAY organo-mineral granular fertilizer at the base rate of 25 g/m², or 250 kg/ha, lets you grow clean, high-protein chickpeas at low cost. When growing chickpeas, it is important to avoid pesticides, because the legume–rhizobium symbiosis on which nitrogen fixation depends is very sensitive to them.
802: Протравители могут мешать формированию клубеньков, в которых идет азотфиксация, и снижать их активность. GREENODIN GRAY по своему действию не уступает химическим протравителям.
Seed treatments can hinder the formation of the nodules where nitrogen is fixed and reduce their activity. GREENODIN GRAY is no less effective than chemical seed treatments.

Chickpea is a cold-tolerant crop. Its seeds start germinating at 2–5 °C, and even emergence comes at 4–8 °C. The crop can withstand frosts down to −8…−10 °C. However, during flowering, pod formation and ripening chickpeas need warmth. Thanks to a well-developed root system and economical water use per unit of dry matter, the crop tolerates drought and heat. Chickpea is a long-day plant with a growing season of 80–120 days. Choosing a variety: varieties differ in tolerance to climate and diseases and in maturity, which ranges from 80 to 120 days.

Chickpeas are not very demanding about their predecessor and can be sown successfully after many crops. However, they should not be grown on the same field continuously. Chickpea monoculture is not effective, and it is recommended to return to the same field no sooner than after four or five years. Growing chickpeas too often on one field can lead to a build-up of diseases and pests such as root and foot rot, fusarium wilt and others. In any case, applying 15 g/m², or 150 kg/ha, of GREENODIN GRAY will take much of the pressure off an unsuitable predecessor.

GREENODIN GRAY вместе с нутом обеспечивает достаточное количество бактерий в почве и благоприятные условия для их развития, что заметно повышает урожайность следующей культуры.
